proof: Replay of Agora dataset handoff admission is idempotent and preserves exact candidate ID without duplicates.
Replay of Imitation candidate HTTP intake to Research authority returns identical task/run IDs.
Replay of Consultation claim recovery reuses acknowledged handoff with zero duplicate OpenClaw turns or Governance handoffs.
Missing downstream Governance handoff sink degrades Consultation executor functional health and enqueues to DLQ; DLQ replay with working sink restores health to ok.
Empty/zero candidate submissions to Research intake fail closed with typed error.
Idle drainer tick with zero pending handoffs produces zero processed/acked counts and cannot satisfy loop execution.
Agora evidence_id correlates to DatasetVersion dsv-ID and durable handoff gh-ID, which Policy Learning binds to candidate record.
Imitation candidate_id correlates to Research experiment_task_id and experiment_run_id confirmed by Research owner readback.
Consultation request_id correlates to published ConsultMemo memo_id and acknowledged ConsultGateHandoff gh-ID confirmed by Governance store readback.
Recovery worker starting from fresh state store recovers terminal acknowledged handoff status without repeating side effects.
DLQ replay mechanism restores healthy status after transient downstream failures.
Failing consumers pause with durable backlog retained and degraded functional health reported.
Direct store write bypass is eliminated; all handoffs use explicit HTTP clients and replay-safe endpoints.

environment_boundary.proof: Only declared task worktree and local test service boundaries were exercised; no external production systems were modified.

no_live_capital.proof: No live capital authority; OpenClaw provider and Consultation requests are strictly paper-only with advisory scope.

rbac.proof: Service actors policy-learning-agora-handoff-drainer and consultation-workflow-executor use distinct tokens and dedicated service actor headers.

tenant_isolation.proof: All Agora, Policy Learning, Research, Consultation, and Governance boundaries enforce explicit tenant binding and reject cross-tenant scopes.

two_person_approval.proof: Owner evidence committed before review; assigned reviewer Claude2 must independently review and bind the final PR head.

acceptance.statement: Three per-loop cases use provider-backed interaction and durable handoffs.
Research and Consultation owner readbacks preserve exact candidate IDs.
Idle zero-candidate ticks cannot satisfy the test.
Replay is idempotent across all three loops and direct ResearchOrchestratorStore imports are absent.
